equity.level_reason: Results are by country, period and host species only; no social-position dimension is reported. Civil unrest and insecurity are geographic access barriers, not tied to an SPD.

level_alternative.reason: Insecurity and mobility of cattle herders could be read as structural access factors, but they are not framed by social position.

equity.equity_measurement: Country-level surveillance only; geography and insecurity are not SPDs.

notes: Percent changes are arithmetic, so no procedures are recorded; laboratory confirmation only establishes case status. Monitoring against the eradication goal is inferred as evaluation or monitoring. Program measures (reward awareness, tethering, temephos coverage) are reported as percentages.
view_issues: Total 2022 animal infections differ (Table 1: 682 indigenous; Table 2 and text: 686); Chad change is −27 in Table 1 and −28 in Table 2. Chad Jan–Jun 2022 dogs are 264 in the Discussion versus 268 animals in Table 2. Cameroon's 56 dogs in the text differ from Table 3's 67 (65) specimens.
